labels.label: bzprop:c1s2p2_base_cone
findings: Witness only (the label is WP-45n's, closed in its corrected form and marked in Cone/Base). DEC-122 FINDING, formalized: for Benzécri's n = 3 (Lean ConeBase 2 V), W = {(x,y,z) : z > 0, (x,y) ≠ 0} ⊂ ℝ³∖0 and A = diag(4, 1/8, 2) ∈ GU(3); the ℤ-action k·v = A^k v is free and properly discontinuous; V = W/⟨A⟩ is Hausdorff, second countable, connected and paracompact, an affine conical manifold with cone charts f_N = (π|N)⁻¹ on N(i,r) = {r z < |v_i| < 2 r z} (i = 0, 1) and transitions A^k; its base is NOT Hausdorff ([(1,0)] and [(0,1)] inseparable: y_k = π(1, 16^{-k}, 1) → π(1,0,1) while 2^k·y_k = π(2^{-k}, 1, 1) → π(0,1,1)). Prop. 2 read with a « variété » base is the Prop Benzecri.ConeCex.Prop2HausdorffBaseAsRead, refuted by Benzecri.ConeCex.not_prop2HausdorffBaseAsRead.

Lean declarations of this witness (not row decls): Benzecri.ConeCex.V, Benzecri.ConeCex.W, Benzecri.ConeCex.A, Benzecri.ConeCex.chart, Benzecri.ConeCex.chart_transition, Benzecri.ConeCex.posSMul_π', Benzecri.ConeCex.not_t2Space_coneBase, Benzecri.ConeCex.not_properSMul, Benzecri.ConeCex.Prop2HausdorffBaseAsRead, Benzecri.ConeCex.not_prop2HausdorffBaseAsRead, Benzecri.ConeCex.counterexample.

labels.label: bzdef:c1s2d3_homotheties_positives
findings: Witness only (the label is closed in its corrected form and marked in Cone/Section, WP-45o). DEC-122 FINDING: « cet espace fibré est topologiquement trivial » fails for the same V: V is homeomorphic to B × ℝ₊* by no homeomorphism at all (Benzecri.ConeCex.isEmpty_homeomorph); the printed form is the Prop Benzecri.ConeCex.Def3TrivialAsPrinted (equivariant trivialisation over B, for every Hausdorff, second countable, connected affine conical 3-manifold), refuted by Benzecri.ConeCex.not_def3TrivialAsPrinted.

prose.statement: « si V est supposé para-compact, on peut donc construire une section de V au-dessus de B »
prose.status: refuted as printed (witness); closed in corrected form in Cone/Section (WP-45o)
prose.finding: DEC-122 FINDING: V is paracompact (Hausdorff, locally compact, second countable) and V → B has no continuous section.

kb_proposals: `ConeBase 2 V` asks for `[ChartedSpace (RnO (2 + 1)) V]`: instance search does not identify `RnO (2 + 1)` with `RnO 3`, so a concrete V must declare its instances in the `n + 1` form (`ChartedSpace (RnO (2 + 1)) V`, `HasGroupoid V (coneGroupoid (2 + 1))`, `HasConeCharts (2 + 1) V`); the same holds for `Fin (1 + 1)`/`Fin (0 + 1)` (no `Unique (Fin (0 + 1))` instance, simp lemmas stated over `Fin 2 → ℝ` do not fire on `Fin (1 + 1) → ℝ`).

A chart which is a local inverse of a quotient map: `OpenPartialHomeomorph.ofContinuousOpenRestrict (Set.InjOn.toPartialEquiv π' N h) …` then `.symm`; the source is `π' '' N`, the target `N`, and `left_inv` gives `f (π' w) = w` by `rfl`-level lemmas.
